fields.name: site
fields.label: Site

options.notes: useEnvData requests /v1/parameter/location?location_type=Site&location_type=Module (ui/src/hooks/useEnvData.ts:34-41); the repeated location_type key is an array, which v1 OptionSource.params (scalar values only) cannot express. Rows are mapped by mapLocationOptions (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:25-36): label = name, value = 'dcim-location:' + JSON [location_type, id] when the row has a location_type, otherwise the bare id. The encoded value is UI-only and is decoded back to id + location_type before use (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:39-59).

fields.query_param_normalization: Single value (searchParams.get('site'), ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:165). Once location options load it is resolved by resolveLocationFormValue against option value (encoded), provider id, or display name; the first match wins (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:62-77). An unmatched value clears site and device (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:228-246). Not re-applied after a manual site change. Nautobot sends the location name.
client_only_validation: Changing or clearing site clears device (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:264-268, 302-312).
Site control disabled while device options load (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:334).
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted. UI-only filter feeding the device option request.

fields.name: tenant
fields.label: Tenant (optional)
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (searchParams.getAll('tenant').filter(Boolean), ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:167-170). After tenant options load, only values equal to an option value (tenant name) are kept; unknown values are dropped (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:279-288). Re-applied when the query string changes; suppressed after a manual change.
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted. Each selected value is sent as a repeated tenant= query parameter on the device option request (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:206-208).

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status (optional)
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (searchParams.getAll('status').filter(Boolean), ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:171-174). After status options load, only values equal to an option value (status name) are kept (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:291-300). Re-applied when the query string changes; suppressed after a manual change.
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted. Each selected value is sent as a repeated status= query parameter on the device option request (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:209-211).

fields.name: device_id
fields.label: Device
fields.schema_description: Identifier of the network device to compare.

options.notes: Query built in ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:205-218 and ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-51. Final order: managed_only=true, one tenant= per selected tenant, one status= per selected status, then site=<decoded location id> and site_type=<decoded location_type> (site_type only when the encoded option carries a type). site/tenant/status are UI-only form fields, not model fields. Not fetched while site is empty (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:53-56). Rows map to {key: name, value: id, platform} (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:59-61). The server requires one site_type per site when site_type is sent (src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/parameter_v1.py:253-257).

fields.query_param_normalization: Single value (searchParams.get('device-id'), ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:166). Accepted only once loaded device options contain an option whose value (device id) equals it; otherwise device is cleared (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:248-262). Suppressed after a manual device change. The form field is named 'device', the query parameter 'device-id', and the payload key 'device_id'.
client_only_validation: Choices limited to NVCM-managed devices (managed_only=true) at the selected site/tenant/status (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:212-218); the schema accepts any device id the DCIM provider resolves (src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/workflow_submission.py:62-90).

fields.name: device
fields.schema_description: Preloaded network device data, if available.
fields.submit_transform: Omitted from the payload, so the server applies the schema default. The API rejects any non-null value with 422 'Preloaded device objects are not accepted by the Workflow API' (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflow_references.py:45-49; src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/workflow_submission.py:69-77).

payload_transform: onSubmit (ui/src/app/workflows/configdiffworkflow/form/page.tsx:30-46) builds {device_id: data.device} and awaits startWorkflow('/v1/workflow/ngc/config_diff', params) (ui/src/lib/utils.tsx:153-184): same fetch options as the other workflows, and navigates to /workflows/{id} on success. On error it shows the toast 'Failed to create workflow: <error>' and rethrows so DeviceWorkflowForm re-enables the form (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:191-199). The site, tenant, status and commit_confirm form values are dropped. No Playwright test asserts the body.
discrepancies: Optional schema field device (nested NetworkDeviceData | null) is never rendered or submitted. The API rejects non-null values anyway.
Only NVCM-managed devices (managed_only=true) can be chosen. The schema has no such restriction.

Nautobot links send a single tenant and a single status value (device tenant name / status name) so the device list includes the target device (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:277-278). This prefill path has no Playwright coverage, and the form itself has no Playwright spec.

These are the only Nautobot workflow links that URL-encode site (`site|urlencode`); the backup/deploy/connected-host/device-cable links do not. Nautobot link values: site = device location name, device-id = Nautobot device pk (components/nautobot/nautobot-nv-config-manager/nv_config_manager/views.py:189-192, 206-210, 260-264, 283-286; components/nautobot/nautobot-nv-config-manager/nv_config_manager/tables.py:45-53, 84-93). tenant = tenant name and status = status name, each added only when non-empty.
contract_gaps: site, tenant and status are UI-only filter fields with no model field. v1 UiHint is keyed by model field, so it cannot describe them. v1 only works if the device_reference widget embeds the site picker and optional tenant/status filters itself. The contract does not define device_reference's sub-controls, the managed_only=true device filter, or the filter option endpoints.
UiHint.query_param holds one name per field, but this form prefills the one submitted field (device_id) from site, device-id, tenant and status (Nautobot sends all four).

Query normalization cannot be expressed: site is matched against option value, id or name; tenant and status are repeated multi-value params filtered against loaded options; device-id is checked against loaded options and cleared if missing.
OptionSource.params is scalar-only, but the location source needs the repeated location_type=Site&location_type=Module.

The location option value is a UI-encoded composite (dcim-location:[location_type,id]) that is decoded into two query params (site and site_type) for /v1/parameter/device. A single value_key or a {query_param: field} depends_on entry cannot express this.
depends_on values for tenant and status are arrays sent as repeated query params. v1 does not define how array values are serialized.
Device options are not fetched until site is set (required dependency), while tenant and status are optional dependencies. v1 depends_on cannot mark a dependency as required or gate the fetch on it.
Changing site, tenant or status clears device, so the generic form needs explicit clear-on-dependency-change behavior.
device is anyOf[$ref NetworkDeviceData (object), null], a nested object the generic renderer cannot edit.
